question.nlq: Please provide a list of all customers that includes, for each customer, (1) the total sum of transaction_amount across all their financial transactions, (2) the count of distinct accounts belonging to the customer, (3) the date of the most recent transaction (or NULL if the customer has no transactions), and (4) a rank ordering customers by total transaction amount in descending order (rank 1 corresponds to the highest total). Customers who have no transactions should appear with a total of 0 and be assigned ranks after all customers with transactions. Order the final result by the rank.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH cust_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count,
        MAX(ft.transaction_date) AS most_recent_transaction
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    account_count,
    most_recent_transaction,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rank
FROM cust_stats
ORDER BY rank;
